title: A preserve on an old cattle ranch
text: The Kern River Preserve, near Weldon, is owned by the National Audubon Society. It covers about 3,000 acres on the former cattle ranch of Andrew Brown, which dates to the 1860s. The preserve was established in 1979. The South Fork Kern River, which flows through it into Lake Isabella, has been a national Wild and Scenic River since 1987. The preserve protects habitat for the federally listed endangered southwestern willow flycatcher.
